status.reason: The protocol profile's model does not implement validation of incoming data as required.

requirements.quote: Incoming data MUST always be validated by both clients and servers.

status.reason: the profile does not model the opening handshake (section 4) or an endpoint's input-safety criteria

requirements.quote: If, at any time, an endpoint is faced with data that it does not understand or that violates some criteria by which the endpoint determines safety of input, or when the endpoint sees an opening handshake that does not correspond to the values it is expecting (e.g., incorrect path or origin in the client request), the endpoint MAY drop the TCP connection.

status.reason: The model does not handle returning HTTP status codes for invalid WebSocket handshake data.

requirements.quote: If the invalid data is sent during the WebSocket handshake, the server SHOULD return an appropriate HTTP [RFC2616] status code.

status.reason: The model does not implement conversion of excluded host characters to ASCII as required.

requirements.quote: Characters in the host component that are excluded by the syntax defined above MUST be converted from Unicode to ASCII as specified in [RFC3987] or its replacement.

status.reason: The model does not implement the required conversion from Unicode to ASCII using UTF-8 and percent-encoding.

requirements.quote: Characters in other components that are excluded by the syntax defined above MUST be converted from Unicode to ASCII by first encoding the characters as UTF-8 and then replacing the corresponding bytes using their percent-encoded form as defined in the URI [RFC3986] and Internationalized Resource Identifier (IRI) [RFC3987] specifications.

status.reason: The protocol profile's model does not implement the required conversion of excluded characters from Unicode to ASCII as specified in [RFC3987] or its replacement.

status.reason: The protocol profile's model does not implement the required Unicode-to-ASCII conversion mechanism for excluded characters.

requirements.quote: Characters in other components that are excluded by the syntax defined above MUST be converted from Unicode to ASCII by first encoding the characters as UTF-8 and then replacing the corresponding bytes using their percent-encoded form as defined in the URI [RFC3986] and IRI [RFC3987] specifications.

status.reason: The protocol profile's model does not enforce restrictions on header field multiplicity.

requirements.quote: The |Sec-WebSocket-Key| header field MUST NOT appear more than once in an HTTP request.

status.reason: The model does not enforce the restriction on multiple occurrences in HTTP responses.

requirements.quote: However, the |Sec-WebSocket-Extensions| header field MUST NOT appear more than once in an HTTP response.

status.reason: the profile does not model the opening handshake (section 4), so no Sec-WebSocket-Accept is sent or checked

requirements.quote: The |Sec-WebSocket-Accept| header MUST NOT appear more than once in an HTTP response.

status.reason: The protocol profile's model does not enforce restrictions on HTTP response header field multiplicity.

requirements.quote: However, the |Sec-WebSocket-Protocol| header field MUST NOT appear more than once in an HTTP response.

status.reason: The model does not allow the Sec-WebSocket-Version header field to appear multiple times in an HTTP response.

requirements.quote: The |Sec-WebSocket-Version| header field MAY appear multiple times in an HTTP response (which is logically the same as a single |Sec-WebSocket-Version| header field that contains all values).
